72a-scale-molecules.png: Scale explorer at 501 pm: Bohr radius, atoms (van der Waals), water, glucose, C₆₀ and the NaCl cell drawn to one scale.
72b-scale-sun.png: The Sun (IAU 2015 nominal radius) beside Jupiter, Earth, Sirius B and the Earth–Moon distance.
72c-scale-observable.png: The comoving radius of the observable universe in Planck 2018 ΛCDM (a model quantity) beside the Hubble distance.
73a-relations-hydrogen.png: Relationship explorer: hydrogen, its NIST spectra and the Sun one step away, and what they link to at two steps.
73b-relations-path.png: Path from hydrogen to cosmic expansion: Sun (Asplund 2009) → Milky Way (Bland-Hawthorn & Gerhard 2016) → distance ladder → expansion (Riess et al. 2022).

74b-compare-redshift.png: NIST H I lines and the Ring Nebula’s [O III] and [N II] lines (NIST rest wavelengths) shifted by 1 + z = 2, beside the refractive index of water (not shifted); the readout gives the rest wavelength.
